<<A Word About Cleaning A Telescope Mirror>>

Cleaning a telescope mirror requires care to maintain its clarity and performance. Use a soft, lint-free cloth or a microfiber towel to gently wipe the surface. Avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive materials that could scratch the mirror. For stubborn dirt, a mild soap solution can be used, but rinse thoroughly and dry immediately. Always work in a clean, dust-free environment. Regular cleaning ensures optimal viewing and long-term use of your telescope.
